from forth import evaluate, StackUnderflowError

cases = [
    ([": inc", "1 + ;", "2 inc"], [3]),
    ([": foo 1 ; : bar foo 2 + ; bar"], [3]),
    (["-8 3 /"], [-2]),
    (["-8 -3 /"], [2]),
    ([": FOO DUP ;", "7 foo"], [7, 7]),
    ([": swap dup ;", ": swap swap swap ;", "1 2 swap"], [1, 1]),
    (["1 2 3 over + +"], [1, 2, 6]),
]
for source, expected in cases:
    actual = evaluate(source)
    assert actual == expected, (source, actual, expected)

underflow_ops = ["+", "-", "*", "/", "dup", "drop", "swap", "over"]
for op in underflow_ops:
    for prefix in ([], ["1"]):
        try:
            evaluate(prefix + [op])
        except StackUnderflowError as exc:
            assert exc.args[0] == "Insufficient number of items in stack", (op, exc.args)
        else:
            raise AssertionError(f"missing StackUnderflowError for {prefix + [op]}")

for source, exc_type, msg in [
    ([": 1 2 ;"], ValueError, "illegal operation"),
    ([": foo 1"], ValueError, "illegal operation"),
    ([";"], ValueError, "illegal operation"),
    ([": foo nope ;", "foo"], ValueError, "undefined operation"),
    (["4 0 /"], ZeroDivisionError, "divide by zero"),
]:
    try:
        evaluate(source)
    except exc_type as exc:
        assert exc.args[0] == msg, (source, exc.args, msg)
    else:
        raise AssertionError(f"missing {exc_type.__name__} for {source}")

print("edge cases passed")
